validation.method: Reviewed Vercel production logs, Vercel production observability, Vercel Alerts plan limitation, and UptimeRobot production HTTP/S monitor with attached notification recipient.

artifacts.description: Vercel Logs page filtered by environment production shows centralized production request logs for eurocomply-saas, including request path, status code, host, timestamp, and application message output.
Vercel Observability page shows production edge requests, function metrics, data transfer, and compute activity for eurocomply-saas.
Vercel Observability Alerts page shows anomaly alerting requires a paid Vercel tier on the current Hobby plan, documenting the external alerting route.
UptimeRobot monitors page shows active HTTP monitoring for eurocomply-saas.vercel.app with current status Up and checks every five minutes.
UptimeRobot monitor detail page shows HTTPS monitoring for https://eurocomply-saas.vercel.app with current status Up and recent successful checks.
UptimeRobot monitor detail page shows response-time tracking and incident history for the production availability monitor.
UptimeRobot status page settings show a public status page for the production monitor.
UptimeRobot test notification dialog shows renanescola40-afk attached as a notification recipient with notify-only user notifications enabled.
